manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: You have cast Nadier no more than three times from the command zone this game.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nadier, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Nadier to the command zone from your graveyard.
Nadier dies, triggering its second ability and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Nadier trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Nadier from the command zone by paying {5}{B} and command tax, if applicable.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
The Elf Warrior dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer and Nadier's first ability.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Nadier trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 8 for each remaining Elf Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.
